verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at arize.com/llms.txt and Markdown versions of the docs (arize.com/docs/phoenix.md), which link to a full documentation index. A Phoenix-specific llms.txt at /docs/phoenix/llms.txt is also cited. Agent-oriented docs go further, with a 'let your coding agent set up tracing' CLI flow and MCP setup instructions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content dump.
